title: Young Indian Shuttler Tanvi Sharma Claims Maiden BWF Super 300 Title at Taipei Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma secured her first BWF Super 300 title, showcasing the rising talent in Indian badminton.
summary: The 17-year-old from Punjab defeated Nguyen in just 36 minutes in the final, marking a significant milestone after her runner-up finish at last year's U.S. Open Super 300.

title: Player Eligibility Announced for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released crucial eligibility criteria for Indian players aspiring to represent the nation at the upcoming World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI has issued guidelines regarding player eligibility for selection to the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, set to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments and Nationals
indian_angle: Indian domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups will now adopt the 3x15 scoring system, impacting young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues and Tournaments
indian_angle: Indian players and the public are advised by BAI to be cautious of unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments, including specific warnings about the Passion Sphere Badminton Premier League.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released an advisory cautioning players and stakeholders against participating in or associating with unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships, citing specific examples like the Passion Sphere Badminton Premier League.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament Held in Chennai
indian_angle: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament, a key event for top Indian players, recently concluded in Chennai.
summary: The Badminton Association of India circulated details for the Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026, which took place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu from July 16th to 23rd.

title: India Invites Expression of Interest for Hosting BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: India has expressed interest in hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, a significant move for Indian badminton on the global stage.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an Expression of Interest (EOI) for potentially hosting the BWF World Championships in 2026, signaling India's ambition to host major international badminton events.
